description: A small spreadsheet workbook in the browser built on the Svelte 5 data grid: five tabs, a formula engine that resolves references across sheets with live recalculation, cell and conditional formatting, validation dropdowns, an inline chart and a calendar planner sheet backed by a data sheet. Budget holds line items with =B*C subtotals and IF status, Price list is the lookup table, Orders uses =VLOOKUP('Price list'!...) with nested IF tiers, Summary sums across sheets with COUNTIF; open an xlsx or csv into the active sheet and export every sheet to one multi-tab xlsx.
keywords: svelte open excel file in browser

faq.question: How do cross-sheet references work?
faq.answer: The engine parses 'Sheet name'!A1 and 'Sheet name'!A1:B9 and resolves them against the named sheet's cells; a change on Price list recalculates the VLOOKUPs on Orders and the sums on Summary in the same pass.

faq.question: Which functions and references are supported?
faq.answer: A1 and $A$1 refs, ranges, whole columns A:C, cross-sheet refs, arithmetic, comparisons and & concat, plus SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, COUNTA, COUNTIF, IF, AND, OR, NOT, ROUND, ABS, LEN, LEFT, RIGHT, UPPER, LOWER, CONCAT, TODAY and VLOOKUP, with #REF!, #CYCLE!, #DIV/0!, #VALUE! and #NAME? errors.

faq.question: How is the workbook exported?
faq.answer: Export all writes every sheet to one xlsx through the enterprise exportData sheets option; the active sheet can also go to csv. Opening a file loads its cells into the active sheet.
